_provenance.purpose: SAP-named successors for deprecated SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition APIs and communication scenarios. The anonymous Hub catalogue exposes State but no Successors field, so this map is the only successor source until a logged-in export provides one. A successor is recorded ONLY where SAP names it; nothing is inferred from names.
sources: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition What's New 2608 (fixed-asset SOAP deprecation, SAP_COM_0563 → SAP_COM_0A93/0A95/0A96; Joule SAP_COM_0882)
_provenance.how_applied: scripts/import-sap-api-catalog.ts and the Hub content importers stamp successorExternalId on the deprecated row; the successor row itself is untouched.

apis.note: Wired in aptus (src/lib/sap-public). Deprecation started CE 2308 (KBA 3365110); WS4 migrates the PO connector.

communicationScenarios.note: Fixed-asset SOAP (FAA_FIXED_ASSET_CREATE_MAIN/SUB/CHANGE_WEBI + confirmations) deprecated as of 2608 → OData V4 API_FIXEDASSET_G4BA via SAP_COM_0A93; acquisition/retirement/revaluation SAP_COM_0A95; usage object SAP_COM_0A96 (What's New 2608; scope items J62, 1GB, 1GF, BFH, 33F, 33G).

new.note: Joule integration with FLP — new in 2608; additional entitlement may be required.

authorisationChanges.note: ACTIVE; additional authorisations required in 2608 (What's New 2608). Wired in aptus — re-test after the tenant's 2608 upgrade (WS4).
